frequent_errors: Faulty contraction and possessive apostrophe placement ('I'am', 'Your's')

Immediate fulfillment of the prompt objective with relevant personal details

feedback_summary: The candidate produced a well-structured informal letter containing all standard structural components and addressing the prompt effectively. The response demonstrates authentic personal planning (freelancing, graphic design, AI). While mechanical slips in spelling and punctuation prevent awarding the full ceiling mark of 5, the script comfortably secures Band 4 at 4 marks.
